_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Player Snake ka gridi ea {width}×{height}.
U na le taolo ya snake {player_id}. Metsamaiso e halalelitsoe: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (kapa w/s/a/d).
Mabapi: a tshepe ka tsela e telele ka nako kapa u be e telele ka mofuta mme u fumane skore e phahameng (mehato ea turn limit {max_turns} turns).

game_action.invalid_death: Noha {player_id} e shoele ka lebaka la ho falla ha eona.

outcome.survived_win: Sebapali {player_id} se ile sa pholoha; ba bang kaofela ba timetse.
outcome.all_dead_simul: Linyoka tsohle li ile tsa shoa ka nako e le 'ngoe.
outcome.outlived: Sebapali se ile sa phela ho feta ba bang kaofela.
outcome.turn_limit: Ho fihleloa moeli oa ho fetoha - e leng motho ea nang le lintlha tse ngata o hlōla tlholisano.
outcome.ranking: {reason} Theko e felletseng ea dikolo (e nyanehetseng → e betere): {groups}
